title.text: City Sightseeing Budapest: Hop-On Hop-Off Bus, Boat + Walking Tour

ratings.heading: Average of 2 sites, weighted by number of reviews

pills.label: 24h €39 · 48h €44 · 72h €49
pills.pop_html: Adult: 24 hours €39, 48 hours €44, 72 hours €49. Child (6 to 18): €35.10, €39.60, €44.10. Children 0 to 5 ride free.Prices for Thursday 17 December 2026.

pills.label: Boat + walking tour included
pills.pop_html: Every ticket includes a Danube boat ride and a 1-hour guided walking tour (daily at 11:00 from Szent István tér 1, in English): Basilica, Parliament, Shoes on the Danube Bank, Váci utca.

pills.label: Buses 9:00 to 17:00
pills.pop_html: First bus from stop 1 at 9:00, last at 17:00, every 10 to 20 minutes. A full loop takes about 110 minutes.Times can change by season.

pills.label: 16 audio languages
pills.pop_html: Recorded commentary with headphones in 16 languages, including English, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Hebrew, Japanese and Chinese. The bus is wheelchair accessible.

best_for.pick_html: if you want the full city loop plus a boat ride for one price, with free cancellation up to 2 days before and child prices up to age 18.
best_for.skip_html: if you only have an afternoon: one loop plus the boat eats most of it, and a 24-hour ticket is cheaper per sight on day two.

items.q: Is City Sightseeing better than Big Bus?
items.a: For most visitors, by a small margin: the same adult prices, but the boat ride is included, cancellation is free up to 2 days before and the child price runs to age 18.
The bus on a 20-stop red route, a Danube boat ride, a 1-hour guided walking tour and a coupon booklet for attractions.

items.q: How long is a full loop?
items.a: About 110 minutes. Start at stop 1 at peak times: one guest waited over an hour at a busy stop.
Once a day in English, at 11:00, so plan your first morning around it.
Children up to 18 pay the child price, and under-6s ride free.

price.note: 48 hours costs €5 more than 24 hours, 72 hours another €5. Free cancellation up to 2 days before.

title.text: Big Bus Budapest: Hop-On Hop-Off Bus Tour with River Cruise

ratings.heading: Average of 2 sites, weighted by number of reviews

pills.label: 1 day €39 · 2 days €44 · 3 days €49
pills.pop_html: Adult (16+): Discover 1 day €39, Essential 2 days €44, Explore 3 days €49. Child (5 to 15): €35.10, €39.60, €44.10. Some dates are discounted to €33.Prices for Thursday 17 December 2026.

pills.label: River cruise + walking tour
pills.pop_html: The ticket includes a Danube river cruise (one boarding) and a guided walking tour of Pest in English: Shoes on the Danube Bank, Parliament, Váci utca.

pills.label: 10:00 to 17:00 · every 10 to 25 min
pills.pop_html: The red route runs from 10:00 to 17:00 with a bus every 10 to 25 minutes. Buses are air-conditioned in summer and heated in winter.

pills.label: 16 audio languages
pills.pop_html: Recorded commentary in 16 languages, plus the free Big Bus app with a route map. Wheelchair accessible.

best_for.pick_html: if you are sure of your dates and want the longest route (21 stops) with a river cruise and a walking tour in the price.
best_for.skip_html: if your plans might change: this ticket is non-refundable. City Sightseeing costs the same and can be cancelled for free.

items.q: Is the Big Bus worth it?
items.a: Yes for a 2 or 3 day ticket, when the cruise, the walk and the extra days bring it to about €16 to €22 a day. For one afternoon, public transport is better value.
From 10:00 to 17:00, every 10 to 25 minutes on the official timetable.
21 stops, one Danube river cruise and a guided walking tour of Pest with every ticket length.
Not this ticket. The flexible Big Bus ticket can be cancelled up to 24 hours before at the same price, with 30% off a cruise instead of a free one.
Yes, the buses are wheelchair accessible, air-conditioned in summer and heated in winter.

title.text: RiverRide Amphibious Bus Tour with Danube Splash

pills.label: 50 min €27 · 90 min €32
pills.pop_html: 50-minute tour from €27: a 25-minute drive through Pest, then the splash and a short river route. 90-minute tour €32: the river part continues to the Parliament.Prices for Thursday 17 December 2026.

pills.label: 3 departures a day in winter
pills.pop_html: Tours leave 3 times a day from November to March and 4 times a day from April to October. On 18 December the 90-minute tour left at 11:00 and 15:00.

pills.label: Parliament on 90 min only
pills.pop_html: The 90-minute tour sails up to the Parliament. On the 50-minute tour the river section is shorter and doesn't reach it.

pills.label: Live guide + 12 audio languages
pills.pop_html: A live guide in English and German, plus headphones with commentary in 12 languages.

best_for.pick_html: if you travel with kids, or want one ride that does both the city and the river: the splash into the Danube is the moment everyone films.
best_for.skip_html: if you want to hop off at sights (it is a fixed tour), or need a toilet or wheelchair access on board.

items.a: The 90-minute tour (€32): only the longer route sails to the Parliament, the best view on the river.
A drive past Andrássy Avenue, the Opera and Heroes' Square, then the bus rolls down a ramp and splashes into the Danube.
Yes: live guiding in English and German, plus audio in 12 languages.

items.q: How often does it run in winter?
items.a: Only 3 tours a day from November to March, so book ahead.

items.q: Is there a toilet on board?
items.a: No, and it is not wheelchair accessible. Food and drinks are not allowed on board.

price.note: Starts at Széchenyi István tér 7, Pest end of the Chain Bridge.

title.text: Official Buda Castle Electric Hop-On Hop-Off Bus

pills.label: €18 · one round
pills.pop_html: €18 per adult for one round of Castle Hill, valid on the day. You can board up to 3 times; the ticket ends when you return to Clark Ádám tér.Prices for Thursday 17 December 2026.

pills.label: 9:00 to 17:00 · about every 20 min
pills.pop_html: On 17 December the bus ran from 9:00 to 17:00. Guests report a bus about every 20 minutes.

pills.label: Open-air electric bus
pills.pop_html: Small open-air electric buses run from the Chain Bridge up the hill. Drivers speak English; there is no audio guide.

pills.label: 5 stops on Castle Hill
pills.pop_html: Stops near Fisherman's Bastion and Matthias Church, the Royal Palace and National Gallery, the Hospital in the Rock, the Labyrinth and Vienna Gate.

best_for.pick_html: if you want Castle Hill without the climb: older travellers, small kids, hot summer days or a second visit after the big loop.
best_for.skip_html: if you are fit and on a budget: bus 16 from Deák Ferenc tér goes up the hill on a normal public transport ticket.

items.a: Yes if walking up Castle Hill is hard for you or it is very hot. If stairs are fine, walk or take bus 16.
Open-air electric buses about every 20 minutes from Clark Ádám tér.
5 stops near Fisherman's Bastion, Matthias Church, the Royal Palace and the Hospital in the Rock.

items.q: How long is the ticket valid?
items.a: One round with up to 3 boardings; it expires when you are back at Clark Ádám tér.
No. The driver speaks English, but it is transport, not a guided tour.

price.note: Free cancellation up to 24 hours before.

pills.label: €35 · 3 hours
pills.pop_html: €35 per adult for a 3-hour coach tour with a live guide, morning or afternoon.Prices for Thursday 17 December 2026.

pills.label: Live guide in English
pills.pop_html: Guided in English, sometimes bilingual (English and Spanish or English and Italian).

pills.label: Start near the Parliament
pills.pop_html: Meet at the Cityrama office, Báthory utca 19, a 5-minute walk from Kossuth Lajos tér (M2).

pills.label: Castle District walk
pills.pop_html: Includes a short walk in the Castle District and a stop at Heroes' Square. Expect some stairs on Castle Hill.

best_for.pick_html: if you have one morning and want a real guide to explain 1,000 years of history while you see both Buda and Pest.
best_for.skip_html: if you want to linger: you can't get off where you like, and entrance fees are not included.

items.q: Hop-on bus or this guided tour?
items.a: This one if you have a morning and want context from a person. A 24-hour hop-on ticket is €4 more but gives you all day and a boat ride, with recorded commentary.
A Castle District walk, Elizabeth Bridge, the Central Market Hall, City Park, Heroes' Square, Andrássy Avenue and the Basilica.

items.q: Can I get off along the way?
items.a: No, it runs on a fixed schedule.
A live guide; some departures are guided in two languages, which slows the commentary.
At the Cityrama office, Báthory utca 19 (M2 to Kossuth Lajos tér or M3 to Arany János utca).

price.note: Free cancellation up to 24 hours before.

title.text: BeerBus Sightseeing Tour with Unlimited Beer

pills.label: €27 · 1 hour
pills.pop_html: €27 per person for a 1-hour ride with unlimited Hungarian beer. Prosecco is €13 per bottle extra (order 24 hours ahead).Prices for Thursday 17 December 2026.

pills.label: 5 departures a day
pills.pop_html: On 17 December: 13:00, 14:15, 15:30, 16:45 and 18:00. It runs whatever the number of passengers.

pills.label: Basilica area to Nyugati
pills.pop_html: Starts at Bajcsy-Zsilinszky út 16 and ends at Nyugati tér, a couple of minutes' walk away.

pills.label: Retractable roof
pills.pop_html: The roof closes in the rain, so the tour runs in any weather.

best_for.pick_html: for a fun hour with friends, a stag or hen do, or solo travellers who want to meet people: unlimited beer and a host who runs games.
best_for.skip_html: if you want to learn about the sights: the music and the host are the show, and it is a 1-hour loop.

items.a: BeerBus for couples, solo travellers and small groups (5 departures a day); E-BeerBus for groups of 4+ who want their own music or a private bus.
Yes, Hungarian draught beer for the whole hour. Prosecco is €13 a bottle, ordered a day ahead.

items.q: Can I join on my own?
items.a: Yes. Departures run regardless of numbers, and solo guests say they felt included.
Drive-bys of Andrássy Avenue, the Opera, Heroes' Square, the Chain Bridge, Gellért Hill and the Parliament.

items.q: Where does it start and end?
items.a: Starts at Bajcsy-Zsilinszky út 16 near the Basilica, ends at Nyugati tér.

price.note: Free cancellation up to 24 hours before.

title.text: E-BeerBus Party City Tour with Unlimited Beer

pills.label: From €27 · private €360
pills.pop_html: Shared tour: from €27 per person, 60, 90 or 120 minutes, minimum 4 people. Private bus: 60 minutes €360, 90 minutes €460, 2 hours €560 for the whole bus.Prices for Thursday 17 December 2026.

pills.label: Electric · roof · toilet break
pills.pop_html: A silent electric bus with a roof, a seat and seat belt for everyone, and a toilet break (about 10 minutes at Oktogon).

pills.label: Your own playlist
pills.pop_html: Play your own music on board. Unlimited Hungarian draught beer is included; prosecco and mixed-drink packages are optional.

pills.label: 18+ only
pills.pop_html: Not for under-18s or wheelchair users. Costumes and nudity are not allowed.

best_for.pick_html: for stag and hen parties or birthdays of 4 or more: your own music, unlimited draught beer, and a private bus for the whole group.
best_for.skip_html: if there are only one or two of you (shared tours need 4 people), or you want real sightseeing: guests say it is about the beer.

items.q: Is it good for a stag party?
items.a: Yes, it is built for it. Split the private 60-minute bus (€360) between 12 friends and it is €30 each, with your own music.

items.q: How many people do we need?
items.a: Shared tours only run with at least 4 participants.
Yes: two buses (14 and 16 seats) can drive together, for up to about 30 people.
Yes, a planned stop.
No costumes, no nudity, and the tour can end early without a refund after repeated warnings.

price.note: Starts at Heroes' Square, next to the Műcsarnok. Free cancellation up to 24 hours before.
